name: Bakunyuu Nurse Choukyou ~Yakan Shift Etsuraku Karte~
original_name: 爆乳ナース調教 ～夜姦シフト悦楽カルテ～
source:
The eyebrow-raising protagonist "Yuuki Tsuzuki" was born and raised in a wealthy family. He chose to live freely in a rural clinic rather than in a large general hospital. He was living a life of leisure in a place where time moves slowly and leisurely.

He replaces Director Kashima, who went abroad and now runs the "Kashima Clinic" in a relaxed manner. Every night, he transforms into a brilliant sadist busily SM training his beloved nurses to suit his own tastes.

Thus begins a twisted love life together with beautiful nurses under the same roof!
